1	// Parses the raw `Tooltip` JSON string returned by the Lost Ark Open API into an
2	// ordered list of { key, type, value } nodes for rendering.
3	export function parseTooltip(raw) {
4	  if (!raw) return []
5	  let obj
6	  try {
7	    obj = JSON.parse(raw)
8	  } catch {
9	    return []
10	  }
11	  if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return []
12	  return Object.entries(obj)
13	    .filter(([, entry]) => entry && entry.type)
14	    .map(([key, entry]) => ({ key, type: entry.type, value: entry.value }))
15	}
16	
> ```

**Running means launching the actual app and interacting with it** —
not the test suite, not an `import` of an internal function and a
`console.log`. The app as a user (human or programmatic) would meet
it: the CLI at its command, the server at its socket, the GUI at its
window.

## First: does a project skill already cover this?

A project skill that launches this app is the repo's verified path —
its author already cold-started from a Linux container and committed
what worked: the exact `apt-get` line, the env vars, the patches, the
driver. Use it instead of rediscovering.

```bash
d=$PWD; while :; do
  grep -Hm1 '^description:' "$d"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md 2>/dev/null
  [ -e "$d/.git" ] || [ "$d" = / ] && break
  d=$(dirname "$d")
done
```

- **One describes launching/driving this app** → read that SKILL.md
  and follow it verbatim. Don't paraphrase; don't skip the patches.
- **Mega-repo, several plausible, no clear match** → ask the user
  which unit to run.
- **Stale** (fails on mechanics unrelated to your task) → tell the
  user; offer to refresh it via `/run-skill-generator`.
- **Nothing about running** → fall back to the patterns below.

## Otherwise: match the shape, use the pattern

Pick the row closest to your project. Each example walks through
launch + first interaction; ignore any trailing "write the skill"
section — you're using the recipe, not authoring one.

| Project type | Handle | Example |
|---|---|---|
| CLI tool | direct invocation, exit code, stdin/stdout | [examples/cli.md](examples/cli.md) |
| Web server / API | background launch + `curl` smoke | [examples/server.md](examples/server.md) |
| TUI / interactive terminal | tmux `send-keys` / `capture-pane` | [examples/tui.md](examples/tui.md) |
| Electron / desktop GUI | Playwright `_electron` REPL under xvfb | [examples/electron.md](examples/electron.md) |
| Browser-driven | dev server + `chromium-cli` script | [examples/playwright.md](examples/playwright.md) |
| Library / SDK | import-and-call smoke script at the package boundary | [examples/library.md](examples/library.md) |

If nothing fits, start from the closest match and adapt. For a web
app, [examples/playwright.md](examples/playwright.md) — drive it with
`chromium-cli`, no custom driver needed. For a desktop app,
[examples/electron.md](examples/electron.md) — it has the `_electron`
REPL driver skeleton and the tmux wrapping.

## Drive it, don't just launch it

Launching with no interaction proves the entrypoint resolves. That's
not running the app — it's typechecking with extra steps. Drive it to
a point where a user would see something:

- CLI → type a representative command, check the exit code and output.
- Server → hit the route the diff touches with `curl`, read the body.
- TUI → `send-keys` a navigation, `capture-pane` the result.
- GUI → click the button, screenshot the window. **Look at the
  screenshot.** A blank frame is a failure to launch.

If the fallback pattern didn't work out of the box — you had to
install packages, set env vars, patch config, or write a driver —
recommend `/run-skill-generator` in your report so that work gets
captured as a project skill. If it just worked, don't.

## 270. Claude

Fixed two real bugs found via a live headless-browser check against your running dev server, both in `battle.css`:

1. **Bullet points** were showing on each effect row (`공격력 Lv. 43` etc.) — the `<ul class="arkgrid-effect-list">` never had `list-style: none` set, so the default disc marker leaked through.
2. **Hover tooltip was clipped to a sliver** ("7%" instead of "공격력 +1.57%") — `overflow-y: auto` on that same list implicitly clips the x-axis too per the CSS spec, cutting off the tooltip that pops out to the left of the row. Removed it (the official page doesn't scroll this list either — it's a fixed-height panel).

Bonus: removing the leftover default `ul` padding also stopped the core names from truncating ("질서의 해 코어 : 파천섬결" now shows in full instead of "...파천…").

Confirmed via screenshot that the icon (34px in a 40px frame), core name color (grade-correct orange for 유물), point badge, and the full-fidelity item tooltip (from hovering a core) all render correctly.

## 290. Claude

Fixed both in `battle.css`:

- **Icon**: was 40px circular (I'd mistakenly added `border-radius: 50%`, but the official frame asset is actually a plain square badge). Now it's a bigger 52px square frame with a 44px rounded-square (6px radius) icon inside, matching your site's existing item-icon convention (equipment icons use the same square treatment).
- **Text wrapping**: the core name had `white-space: nowrap` + ellipsis, which cut off longer names instead of wrapping. Now it wraps normally (`white-space: normal`) and the row height grows (`min-height` instead of fixed `height`) to fit two lines when a name is long enough to need it.

Verified with a screenshot — icons are visibly bigger and square now, and the row layout no longer clips text.

## 373. Claude

Wired Ark Grid data into the Damage Analysis tab (`DamageAnalysis.jsx`):

**New automatic data pulled in:**
1. **"아크그리드 효과"** row in the API-confirmed grid — shows all always-on stat bonuses from equipped cores (e.g. "공격력 Lv.43 · 낙인력 Lv.19 · 추가 피해 Lv.39 · 아군 피해 강화 Lv.20 · 아군 공격 강화 Lv.17 · 보스 피해 Lv.12").
2. **`ARK_GRID_DAMAGE`** (previously a permanent "미입력" placeholder) — now auto-resolves when a core's "코어 옵션" text mentions the currently-selected skill by name, scanning each core's tooltip the same way `gemFacts` already does for gems. Expanding it lists the exact matched sentences per core (e.g. "[17P] 천하섬멸옥의 피해량이 35.0% 증가한다."), with a note that point-threshold/activation conditions still need manual confirmation.
3. **`WEAPON_ATK`** auto-scan now also includes each core's "코어 옵션" text (reusing the same 무기 공격력 regex already applied to equipment/Ark Passive), so any class whose cores grant flat/% weapon attack picks it up automatically — the manual 아크그리드 input fields stay only as a fallback for whatever text-parsing misses.

**Verified**: build passes; confirmed live against the real backend that `armory.ArkGrid.Effects` renders correctly in the new row, and unit-checked the skill-name matching logic against the actual core-option text (extracts precise per-point bonuses like the `[18P]`/`[19P]`/`[20P]` lines) — the test character's currently-equipped skill list just doesn't happen to include a name that appears in their core text, so that row correctly shows unresolved for them, which is expected per-character behavior rather than a bug.

Done. The 주 스탯(MAIN_STAT) breakdown now takes exactly 3 user inputs, each with a fixed fallback when left blank:

1. **물약+원정대 레벨 효과로 오른 수치** — enter the combined number shown in-game; 물약 효과 is derived as `입력값 − 원정대 레벨 효과`. Left blank → 물약 효과 defaults to a flat **850**.
2. **카드 도감 효과** — used directly as entered. Left blank → defaults to a flat **242**.
3. **펫 특기 %** — used directly as entered (0~1). Left blank → defaults to **1%**.

원정대 레벨 효과 and 레벨에 따른 주스탯 stay fully automatic from the level tables (unchanged). Verified in-browser: with all three inputs empty, the rows correctly show "미입력 · 850 고정" / "미입력 · 242 고정" / "미입력 시 1% 고정"; filling in 1795/500/0.6 correctly recomputed to +1,000 / +500 / +0.60%.

## 584. Claude

Summary of what changed:

- **Renamed** `BASE_ATK_RATE`'s label from "기본 공격력 증가 배율" to plain **"기본 공격력"**.
- **Auto-detection added**: scans equipment (ability stones' 레벨 보너스, accessories' 연마 효과), Ark Passive, and Ark Grid core/gem tooltips for any "기본 공격력 +N%" text, plus pulls the gem system's own ready-made "기본 공격력 총합" aggregate (used as a single source instead of re-summing each gem individually, which would double-count).
- **최종 기본 공격력 계산**: `기본 공격력(√(주스탯 × 무기 공격력 ÷ 6)) × (1 + 기본 공격력 증가 배율 합계)`, shown in its own resolved, expandable row with the full source list.

Verified end-to-end against the real character: 151,538 × (1 + 8.90%) = **165,024**, matching the actual in-game "기본 공격력" (165,009) almost exactly.

## 683. Claude

Done. Summary of the two changes in this turn:

1. **최종 공격력 (FLAT_ATK / ATK_RATE) added** — new "공격력" (plain, not 무기/기본/아군) flat & percent scanner across 장비, 각인, 아크패시브, 아크그리드 (with point-threshold-aware core option parsing, splitting compound lines like `[17P] 1.10% 증가하고, 추가로 1800 증가` into separate flat/percent contributions), plus the ArkGrid gem "공격력" aggregate (using the API's own summed field to avoid double-counting). Conditional/stacking buffs (e.g. 아드레날린 각인) are correctly separated out rather than polluting the permanent total. Validated against the real character: computed **178,592** vs the actual API value of **178,577**.
2. **Decimals preserved end-to-end** — removed every `Math.floor()` from the calculation chain (주스탯 → 무기 공격력 → 기본 공격력 → 최종 기본 공격력 → 최종 공격력) and widened `numberText` to show up to 4 fraction digits, so no step silently truncates precision before feeding the next.

## 735. Claude

방금 실제 API 응답(`GET /armories/characters/{name}`)을 다시 받아서 `ArmoryProfile.Stats` 배열을 직접 확인했습니다. 결과는 이렇습니다.

**"최종 공격력 ATK"는 100% 진짜 API 값입니다.**
`ArmoryProfile.Stats` 배열에 `{Type:"공격력", Value:"178577"}` 형태로 그대로 들어있습니다. 이 배열에는 정확히 8개 항목만 있습니다: **치명, 특화, 제압, 신속, 인내, 숙련, 최대 생명력, 공격력**. 그대로 읽어오는 값이라 신뢰할 수 있습니다.

**"주 스탯 민첩"(544,380.9)은 진짜 API 값이 아닙니다.**
로스트아크 API는 **힘/민첩/지능을 어디에도 필드로 주지 않습니다.** `ArmoryProfile.Stats`를 아무리 뒤져도 없고, 유일하게 등장하는 곳은 장비 하나하나의 툴팁 HTML 텍스트 안입니다 (예: 투구 툴팁 안에 `"힘 +108406<BR>체력 +10791"`처럼 박혀있음, 회색 처리된 건 직업에 안 맞는 스탯). 그래서 이 값은:

1. 장비 6~7개 툴팁을 정규식으로 긁어서 힘/민첩/지능 고정치 합산 (실측이긴 한데, 툴팁 텍스트 파싱이라 형식이 바뀌면 깨질 수 있음)
2. 아바타 %, 원정대 레벨 테이블, 캐릭터 레벨 테이블 (이건 정확)
3. **물약 효과·카드 도감 효과 — 사용자가 입력 안 하면 850/242로 그냥 고정값을 넣습니다 (API에 없어서 제가 임의로 정한 기본값)**
4. **아제나의 축복 — 토글 켜면 +6000, 이것도 API와 무관한 수동 입력**

이렇게 여러 단계를 합쳐서 만든 **근사치**입니다. API가 직접 주는 숫자가 아니라, 제가 여러 출처를 조합해서 "이 정도일 것이다"라고 계산한 값이라는 뜻입니다. 특히 물약(850)·카드도감(242) 기본값은 이 계정의 실제 수치가 아니라 그냥 플레이스홀더라서, 실제 값을 입력창에 넣지 않으면 최종 결과가 조금 어긋납니다 (이전 검증 때 실제 공격력 178,577 대비 178,592로 15 정도 차이 났던 게 이 부분 때문입니다).

정리하면 API 그리드에서 지금 보이는 항목들의 진짜 출처:
- **완전히 API 그대로**: 최종 공격력 ATK, 스킬 레벨, 선택 트라이포드, 적용 보석, 장착 룬, 아크그리드 효과
- **API 텍스트를 파싱/추출**: 기본 쿨타임 후보, 공격 특성, 툴팁 표기 피해 후보 (스킬 툴팁 문자열에서 정규식으로 뽑음)
- **API + 계산 + 수동입력 조합(근사치)**: 주 스탯 (힘/민첩/지능)

"주 스탯" 라벨에 "· 근사치"라고 이미 붙어있긴 한데, 그리드 카드 자체는 다른 완전-API 항목들과 똑같이 초록 체크로 표시돼서 헷갈릴 수 있겠네요. 원하시면 근사치 항목은 시각적으로 구분(예: 다른 색 아이콘이나 "근사치" 배지)해서 진짜 API 값과 구분되게 바꿔드릴까요?

## 1011. Claude

Clean. Let's do a final summary.

Added a "계산 설정" panel to the Damage Analysis page with:
- **아제나의 축복** on/off toggle
- **펫 특기 (주스탯)** / **(악세서리 추가 피해)** / **(추가 피해)** — three separate % inputs (previously only one generic pet-trait field existed)
- A **저장** button

**Persistence** (verified end-to-end):
- Save always writes to `localStorage` keyed per character name (`{characterName: {...}}`), so switching characters loads that character's own saved values.
- If logged in, saving to localStorage automatically triggers the app's existing debounced cloud-sync (reused `lib/auth.jsx`'s established mechanism — same one already used for honing materials), which pushes to the backend DB. Not logged in → stays local-only, as the panel's own status text tells the user.
- Backend: added `damage_analysis_settings` column to `UserPreference` (Hibernate auto-migrates on restart since `ddl-auto=update`), wired into the existing `GET`/`PUT /api/user-data` endpoints alongside the other synced preferences.

**Bonus**: wired the 악세서리/추가 피해 pet-trait values into the `ACCESSORY_ADDITIONAL`/`PET_ADDITIONAL` rows in the "추가 피해 계산" group — they now resolve (green, expandable) once a value is entered, instead of sitting as permanent "미입력" placeholders.

One thing to flag: I couldn't compile/restart the Java backend from this environment (no JDK on PATH here), so **the backend needs a restart** to pick up the `UserPreference`/`AccountController` changes and let the DB-sync half actually take effect — until then, saves will still work locally for everyone, but won't sync to DB even when logged in.

## 1280. Claude

Good, no stray process left running. Summary of everything done this turn:

**추가 피해 (Additional Damage) — now auto-detected and listed:**
- **무기 추가 피해**: weapon item's own stat + Ark Passive evolution node + Ark Grid (core options, point-threshold-aware + gem aggregate) — all fold into the same "무기 추가 피해" pool, matching how the game tracks it as one stat. Verified: **+33.67%** (28.82% weapon + 1.7% ark passive + 3.15% ark grid — exact match with hand-calculation).
- **장신구 추가 피해**: 목걸이/귀걸이/반지 연마 효과only. Verified: **+0.70%**.
- **팔찌 추가 피해**: 팔찌 효과 text only (separate bucket per the formula). Correctly shows 미입력 for this character (no roll).
- Deliberately **excluded** skill/tripod tooltip "N% 추가 피해를 준다" text — that describes a skill's own per-hit damage calculation, not the character-wide additional-damage stat, so mixing it in would have inflated the number incorrectly. Flagged this reasoning in case that's not what you intended.

**UI fixes:**
- 물약+원정대/카드도감 inputs now span the full settings-panel width instead of being squeezed into a half column.
- Removed the now-redundant "아크그리드 무기 공격력 고정/퍼센트 증가" manual inputs (auto-detection already covers this).
- **Result values now show inline** on every resolved row (e.g. "178,594.5732 ▼", "+33.67% ▼") without needing to click "상세 보기" — click still expands the full breakdown.
- Bonus fix: found and fixed a pre-existing overlap bug where long variable codes (e.g. `MOTION_COEFFICIENT`) visually collided with their label text — widened the code column and let it wrap instead.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - React functional components with hooks (useState, useEffect) in a single large `DamageAnalysis.jsx` file
   - Lost Ark Open API armory JSON structure: `ArmoryProfile`, `ArmoryEquipment`, `ArmoryEngraving` (with `Effects`/`ArkPassiveEffects`, each engraving has a `Level` field — Level 0 means the engraving occupies a slot but is NOT actually active, shown as "x0" in-game UI), `ArkPassive` (`Effects` array with nodes using `Element_000` as NameTagBox object + `Element_002` as MultiTextBox description, NOT the simple string-heading pattern used by equipment), `ArkGrid` (`Slots` with `Point`-gated `[NP]` bracket core options + `Effects` aggregate stats), `ArmoryCard.Effects[].Items[]`, `ArmoryGem`

   - `flattenTooltipStrings(raw)` — different generic parser that recursively flattens ALL string leaves regardless of structure — DOES work correctly for ArkPassive (used in `baseAttackRateBreakdown`)

## Two bugs found and fixed during this pass

1. **ArkPassive tooltip parser was silently broken.** The generic `tooltipSections()` helper assumed `Element_000` is always a plain string heading, but Ark Passive nodes store it as `{type:"NameTagBox", value:...}` — an object. Every scan that touched Ark Passive data (공격력, 추가 피해, 무기공격력) was returning zero matches from that source without erroring, so their totals were quietly undercounted. I wrote `arkPassiveNodeText()` to extract `Element_000.value`/`Element_002.value` correctly and retrofitted all three call sites. One consequence: a number I reported to you earlier this session (WEAPON_ADDITIONAL = 33.67%) was wrong at the time — the real live value was 31.97%, missing a 1.7% Ark Passive contribution that this fix now picks up.

2. **Level-0 engravings were being counted as active.** An engraving occupying a slot with `Level: 0` is inactive in-game (shown as "×0"), but my new `engravingDamageFacts()` and `critDamageBreakdown()` scans didn't check `Level`, so they included 저주받은 인형 (14.00%, Level 0) and 예리한 둔기 (44%, Level 0) as if active. Fixed with `Level > 0` guards in both places, plus defensively in the pre-existing `attackPowerBreakdown` engraving loop (same bug class, didn't happen to affect this character's numbers but could for others).

## What's still 미입력 and why (Group 4 + a few Group 5/6/7 items)

These genuinely can't be derived from a single character's armory data:
- **All of Group 4** (적받는피해 증가): depends on the *target's* defense state and party debuffs — not present in any armory endpoint.
- **RAID_CAPTAIN_DAMAGE**: needs real-time move speed, not a static stat.
- **SPECIALIZATION_DAMAGE**: class-specific formula, not a generic armory field.
- **EQUIPMENT_SET_DAMAGE**: no set-effect data exposed by the API for this gear type.
- **CRIT_HIT_SYNERGY**: party-synergy dependent, not solo-character data.

These are correctly left as 미입력 rather than silently guessed at.

## 1625. Claude

Both changes are done and verified:

**1. 계산 설정 moved + 마을 기준 최종 공격력 added** — the settings panel now sits directly under the "스킬 데미지 데이터 확인" header (applies globally, not nested under skill selection), with a "마을 기준 최종 공격력" box beside it showing the live final-attack-power value (already computed with all combat-conditional bonuses excluded, matching the existing `attackPowerBreakdown`/`weaponAttackBreakdown` logic).

**2. Settings split into per-character vs per-expedition** — 아제나의 축복 stays per-character (each character toggles independently); pet trait (주스탯/악마 계열/추가 피해), 물약+원정대 레벨 수치, and 카드 도감 수치 are now shared across the whole 원정대. The expedition key is derived from the sorted sibling-roster list (`ServerName:CharacterName`), mirroring the same `rosterKey` logic the backend already uses for roster snapshots — verified live that saving on 현승꾸 instantly appears when viewing sibling 사나이최현승, while each character's own 아제나의 축복 stays independent.

Also bumped the local-storage schema version (the existing versioning mechanism in `localData.js`) since the storage shape changed from a flat character map to `{characters, expeditions}` — this safely clears old-format cached settings rather than trying to migrate them.

## 1814. Claude

Everything's implemented and verified end-to-end:

**1. Stack-based conditional data-ized** — bracelet effects like "공격 적중 시 ... 무기 공격력이 N 증가 (최대 M중첩)" now compute their applied value using a fixed **12-stack assumption** (capped to the source's actual max if lower — confirmed working on a real bracelet capped at 6). A "조건부 중첩 스택 보기" button on that row expands a detail panel showing 스택당 값 / 적용 중첩 / 최대 중첩 / 적용값, plus the original tooltip text.

**2. Only data-ized conditionals auto-apply** — sources with a defined stack model (`maxStacks` detected) are checked by default; everything else (like 아드레날린 각인 buffs with no defined activation model) stays unchecked until the user manually toggles it. Resets to these defaults whenever the character changes.

**3. 마을 기준 vs 계산식 상세 are now separate values** — "마을 기준 최종 공격력" (the box) always excludes every conditional, fixed, matching the in-game town-state stat regardless of what's toggled. The calculation shown in the modal (and the ATTACK_POWER_FINAL row below) is a distinct number that adds in whatever conditionals are currently checked — verified the box stayed at 169,339.1536 throughout while the modal's staircase total showed 173,114.8339 with the bracelet stack applied.

## 1907. Claude

Yes, exactly right. It's a two-level structure:

**Within "진화형 피해" (EVOLUTION_DAMAGE)** — `arkPassiveTierDamageBreakdown(armory, '진화')` ([DamageAnalysis.jsx:572-589](front/src/components/DamageAnalysis.jsx#L572-L589)) finds every equipped Ark Passive **진화** node, and sums (`reduce`, plain addition) all their "주는 피해" bonuses that aren't conditional:

```js
total: unconditional.reduce((sum, source) => sum + source.value, 0)
```

So if you had e.g. two 진화 nodes each giving +5% and +3%, `evolutionDamage.total` = 8% — a single summed number for that whole category.

**Across the 8 categories in "최종 피해 증가"** — that summed 8% then becomes ONE entry in `damageIncreaseItems`:

```js
{ key: 'EVOLUTION_DAMAGE', label: '진화형 피해', percent: evolutionDamage.total }
```

and gets folded into the product as `×(1 + 8/100)` alongside 각인/깨달음/종족/카드/질량증가/도약/주는피해 — those 8 terms multiply together, not add.

So: **합연산 inside each category → 곱연산 across categories**. On the character we tested, 진화형 피해 happened to total 0% (no matching nodes equipped), which is why it showed `×1.0000 (+0.00%)` in the breakdown — but the mechanism is there and will pick up real values the moment a character has 진화 nodes with "주는 피해" text.

1	// Parses the raw `Tooltip` JSON string returned by the Lost Ark Open API into an
2	// ordered list of { key, type, value } nodes for rendering.
3	export function parseTooltip(raw) {
4	  if (!raw) return []
5	  let obj
6	  try {
7	    obj = JSON.parse(raw)
8	  } catch {
9	    return []
10	  }
11	  if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return []
12	  return Object.entries(obj)
13	    .filter(([, entry]) => entry && entry.type)
14	    .map(([key, entry]) => ({ key, type: entry.type, value: entry.value }))
15	}
16	
> ```

## 2094. Claude

Added a **"보유 데이터 전체 목록"** panel directly below the 장착 스킬 list, with 8 tabs matching your list — 장비(10)/악세서리(5)/팔찌(1)/스킬 트라이포드(22)/아크그리드(6)/아크패시브(18)/보석(11)/각인(5), counts shown live on each tab:

- **장비/악세서리/팔찌/아크그리드/보석** — real game tooltip JSON exists for these, so hovering an item pops up the full game-style tooltip (grade, item level, effect text, everything) via the same `ItemTooltip` component used elsewhere in the site.
- **스킬 트라이포드** (선택된 것만) / **아크패시브** / **각인** — these don't have a usable tooltip JSON blob (tripods have plain HTML text, engravings have no tooltip field at all), so instead their cleaned description text is shown inline right under the name.

This is a pure reference/audit view — it doesn't feed into any calculation, just lets you see everything the armory data actually contains, whether or not it's already wired into a damage-calc row.

## 2148. Claude

Replaced the card-based sidebar panel with a modal — a small trigger panel ("보유 데이터 원본 줄 목록" / "전체 목록 보기" button) sits below 장착 스킬, and clicking it opens a modal with the 8 category tabs. Selecting a category dumps every raw line from that category's tooltips, each tagged `[출처]`, e.g.:

```
[팔찌] 특화 +77
[팔찌] 신속 +72
[팔찌] 무기 공격력 +8100
[팔찌] 적에게 주는 피해가 3% 증가한다.
[팔찌] 스킬의 재사용 대기 시간이 2% 증가하지만, 적에게 주는 피해가 5.5% 증가한다.
[팔찌] 도약 +18
```

Verified across all 8 categories (장비/악세서리/팔찌/스킬 트라이포드/아크그리드/아크패시브/보석/각인) — each pulls from wherever its actual source text lives (JSON tooltip sections for equipment/accessories/ark grid/gems, the plain-HTML tooltip for tripods, the description text for engravings, and the parsed node text for ark passive), tagged with `[Type]` or `[Category · ItemName]` so you can trace which line came from where.

## 2246. Claude

Each line in the raw-lines modal now shows exactly where it's currently applied. Every line gets a badge on the right:

- **초록 "적용 중 · [계산명]"** — this text was matched by a live damage-calc scan and is actually feeding into a result right now (e.g. `[팔찌] 무기 공격력 +8100` → "적용 중 · 무기 공격력", `[투구] 힘 +108406` → "적용 중 · 주 스탯(힘) 고정 출처").
- **회색 "미적용"** — this line exists in the raw tooltip but nothing in the calc currently consumes it (e.g. 방어력/체력/특화/신속/도약 stats — genuinely not wired into any DPS-related calc yet).

This isn't a fresh re-scan with new rules — it reuses the exact same computed breakdown results already driving the visible calc rows (`mainStatData`, `weaponAttack`, `attackPower`, `최종 추가 피해`, each `최종 피해 증가` sub-term, `치명타 피해`, etc.), so the badge is a truthful reflection of what's actually being calculated, including all the existing exclusion rules (Level 0 engravings, conditional-only bonuses, double-counting guards).

## 2304. Claude

Confirmed — this was a real calculation bug, not just a display issue. **최종 피해 증가 jumped from +59.48% to +148.80%** because 진화형 피해 (Evolution-type damage) was being silently skipped entirely (0% → 56.00%, matching the sum of 예리한 감각(10%) + 한계 돌파(10%) + 혼신의 강타(4%) + 분쇄(20%) + 입식 타격가(12%) exactly). ## 2307. Claude

Found and fixed two real bugs, not just display issues:

**1. Ark Passive tier-damage pattern mismatch (the "적용은 한군데서밖에 안돼" bug)** — `EVOLUTION_DAMAGE`/`ENLIGHTENMENT_DAMAGE`/`LEAP_DAMAGE` were only scanning for the phrase "주는 피해" (giving damage), but the actual game text for진화/깨달음/도약 nodes almost always says "OO형 피해" (e.g. "진화형 피해가 10.0% 증가합니다") — completely different wording that the old regex could never match. This meant most evolution/enlightenment/leap damage bonuses were silently computed as 0% even though they were clearly present in the data.

- **Impact**: 최종 피해 증가 for this character went from **+59.48% → +148.80%** — 진화형 피해 alone was 56% that had never been counted.

**2. Gem base-attack lines never cross-referenced** — individual "기본 공격력 X% 증가" lines from each gem legitimately feed into the total only via the API's pre-summed "기본 공격력 총합" field (to avoid double-counting), so they never matched any per-item source. Fixed by recognizing this pattern specifically for gem lines in the audit index (display-only, doesn't touch the actual calculation, which was already correct).

After both fixes, applied-badge coverage went from 아크패시브 1/26 → 9/26 and 보석 0/13 → 11/13. 스킬 트라이포드 stays 0/3 correctly — tripods genuinely aren't wired into any calc yet (T1/T2/T3 remain listed as 미입력, unchanged).

## 2399. Claude

Both changes done and verified:

**1. 달인 fixed at 5중첩** — extended the same stack-detection logic used for weapon-attack stacking bonuses to `additionalDamageBreakdown`'s "추가 피해" scanning, since this exact pattern ("X% / Y%, 최대 N중첩") also appears there. 달인's 추가 피해 went from an incorrectly-flat **+1.70% → +8.50%** (1.7% × 5 stacks, capped correctly at its actual max of 5). This also fixed the real calculation, not just a display value — 최종 추가 피해 is now higher by the difference.

**2. "조건부 확인하기" button + modal** — added directly below the 마을 기준 최종 공격력 box. Clicking it opens a dedicated modal listing every conditional that's been "데이터화" (given a fixed stack assumption baked permanently into the calc, as opposed to the toggle-based ones in the formula modal). Right now it shows the one entry: `[최종 추가 피해] "달인 : 치명타 적중률 +1.4% / 추가 피해 +1.7%, 최대 5중첩"` → `5/5중첩 적용 · +8.5%`. As more stacking conditionals get data-ized in either 무기 공격력 or 최종 추가 피해, they'll automatically show up here too.

## 2401. Claude

It's all in one file: **`front/src/components/DamageAnalysis.jsx`**. No separate data file — everything is computed live from the character's armory data. Key spots:

- **`DataizedConditionalsModal`** component — renders the "조건부 확인하기" modal itself (the list UI).
- **`dataizedConditionalItems`** — built inside the main `DamageAnalysis` component body, right after `additionalDamageFinalTotal` is computed. It just filters `weaponAttack.conditional` and `additionalDamageFinalSources` down to whichever entries have a `maxStacks` field set.
- **`DEFAULT_STACK_ASSUMPTION = 12`** — the constant controlling the fixed-stack assumption (near `weaponAttackBreakdown`).
- **`scanAdditionalDamagePercents`** and **`weaponAttackBreakdown`**'s scan logic — where `maxStacks`/`appliedStacks`/`perStackValue` actually get detected from the raw "최대 N중첩" tooltip text in the first place.

There's no static/JSON list anywhere — the "list" is just whatever conditional sources happen to match a "최대 N중첩" pattern in that character's current gear/passives, recomputed every render.

## 2538. Claude

Data is now managed via **`front/src/data/damage-analysis-conditional-stacks.json`**. Final design, matching your corrections:

- **Matched by sentence pattern, not item name** — a `pattern` field holds a real example sentence you've seen; matching works even if the same mechanic shows up on a different item/character.
- **"최대 N중첩" stays literal** in the match — that number is a fixed part of the effect's design, so two different effects with different max-stack counts won't collide.
- **Only the stat-value numbers get wildcarded** (무기 공격력 값, 치명타 적중률/추가 피해 %, timing numbers) — those vary by roll/character and are ignored for matching.
- **`appliedStacks` is an explicit per-pattern override**, not a generic cap — you set exactly what you want (e.g. 5 for 달인, 11 for the bracelet pattern), independent of the actual detected max.

To add a new data-ized conditional going forward: open that JSON, paste in the real sentence you saw in a tooltip as `pattern`, set `appliedStacks` to whatever number you want assumed, and it'll auto-apply for any character whose gear/passives produce a matching sentence — no code changes needed.

## 2571. Claude

Rewritten as you suggested — `damage-analysis-conditional-stacks.json` patterns now use explicit `N` placeholders directly in the sentence template (e.g. `"공격 적중 시 N초마다 N초 동안 무기 공격력이 N 증가한다. (최대 30중첩)"`), instead of my code guessing which numbers to wildcard from a concrete example. Each `N` compiles into a `[\d.]+` regex wildcard at load time, while numbers you leave as literals (like the "30" in "최대 30중첩") must match exactly. This gives you full explicit control — write the sentence with `N` wherever a value can legitimately differ, and leave real numbers wherever they're a fixed part of the effect's spec.

## 2721. Claude

Done — the "장비" tab now shows 6 items (보주 removed entirely), and every armor piece (투구/상의/하의/장갑/어깨) has its 물리 방어력/마법 방어력/생명 활성력/진화 lines filtered out, leaving only 힘/체력 (plus 무기's own 무기 공격력/추가 피해 lines untouched). ## 2992. Claude

Reorganized as requested:
- **Group 5 (치명타 확률 계산)**: now just `CRIT_RATE` (moved out of the old catch-all Group 7)
- **Group 6 (치명타 피해 증가 계산)**: now has all four crit-damage-multiplier items together — `CRIT_DAMAGE` (moved from old Group 5) + `CRIT_HIT_EVOLUTION`/`CRIT_HIT_BRACELET`/`CRIT_HIT_SYNERGY` (already there)

Also, to recap everything else fixed this turn:
1. **Group 3 cleanup**: removed the 5 separate rows (돌격대장/특화/보석/아크그리드/장비세트) — 보석·아크그리드 data now folds directly into "최종 피해 증가"'s multiplication; the other 3 (still undetectable) are just noted in that row's description rather than cluttering the list.
2. **목걸이 연마 "적에게 주는 피해"** now counted — the pattern required a literal "증가" suffix that honing-effect text doesn't have.
3. **"OO 스킬의 피해량" wording** (기공/각성/일반/악마 스킬 등) now recognized as its own pattern — this was a completely different phrasing than "주는 피해" that nothing previously caught.
4. **아크그리드 Effects aggregate** (e.g. "보스 피해") now scanned, matching the same aggregate-reading approach already used for 기본 공격력/추가 피해.
5. **"감소" now treated as a genuine negative**, not silently dropped — fixed the resulting double-sign display bug and the filter that was hiding categories whose total went negative.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - React functional components with hooks (useState) in `DamageAnalysis.jsx`
   - Lost Ark Open API armory JSON structure: `ArmoryEquipment` (Type values include 무기/투구/상의/하의/장갑/어깨/목걸이/귀걸이/반지/팔찌/어빌리티 스톤/나침반/부적/보주/문장), `ArmoryEngraving`, `ArkPassive` (Effects with NameTagBox/MultiTextBox structure), `ArkGrid` (Slots with Point-gated `[NP]` core options, plus a separate `Effects` aggregate array like `기본 공격력 총합`/`추가 피해`/`공격력`/`보스 피해`/`낙인력`/`아군 피해 강화`/`아군 공격 강화`), `ArmoryCard`, `ArmoryGem` (`Gems` array + `Effects.Skills` slot→skill mapping)
   - `cleanApiText(value)` from `lib/text.js`: replaces `<br>` with space, strips all HTML tags, decodes entities, collapses whitespace, trims — CRITICALLY this means calling `cleanApiText(x).replace(/<br>/gi,' | ')` (clean-then-replace) is a NO-OP for the replace since cleanApiText already consumed `<br>` — the CORRECT order (used by `tooltipSections`) is `value.replace(/<br>/gi,' | ')` THEN `cleanApiText(...)`.
   - **Korean regex gotcha**: `\b` (word boundary) does NOT work with Hangul characters in JS regex (Hangul isn't in `\w`), causing silent match failures — must use lookaheads like `(?=\s|$)` instead.
   - **Engraving Description text is NOT split by `<br>`** in the scanning pipeline used by `attackPowerBreakdown`/`critDamageBreakdown`'s engraving loops (`cleanApiText(engraving.Description).replace(/<br>/gi,' ')` — no-op replace as above) — meaning a multi-sentence engraving description arrives as ONE long "line" for pattern-matching purposes; JSON conditional-stack `pattern` entries for engravings must include the ENTIRE multi-sentence text, not just the relevant sentence.
   - **Pattern matching for data-ized conditionals**: `front/src/data/damage-analysis-conditional-stacks.json` (currently version 4) holds `entries: [{pattern, appliedStacks, note}]` where `pattern` is a real observed sentence with literal "N" substituted at every point-value that varies by item roll, while numbers that are fixed specs of the effect (e.g. "최대 30중첩") are left as literal digits. At runtime, `patternToMatcher(pattern)` strips all whitespace, escapes regex metacharacters, then replaces literal "N" with `[\d.]+`, producing an anchored `^...

 RegExp. Matching is whitespace-agnostic (`stripWhitespace` removes ALL whitespace, not just collapses it) specifically to avoid a real bug where "N초마다" (no space) in the JSON didn't match live "N초 마다" (with space) text.
   - **"조건부 확인하기" modal**: shows only conditionals whose pattern is registered in the JSON (i.e., truly "데이터화"), each with its actual detected value/stacks; distinct from the "계산식 보기" modal's checkbox-toggle conditionals (which apply the *generic* `DEFAULT_STACK_ASSUMPTION = 12` cap when not JSON-registered).
   - **Line-level vs match-level filtering ("qualifier" precision bug)**: `scanOutgoingDamage(text)` iterates lines (split by `|`) then does `.matchAll(OUTGOING_DAMAGE_PATTERN)` per line, so a SINGLE line can yield MULTIPLE matches, each with its own `qualifier` (capture group 1, the text immediately preceding "주는 피해") but the SAME shared `line` text. Verified via a direct Node test: for the compound sentence `"적에게 주는 피해가 1.00% 추가로 증가하고, 치명타 시 적에게 주는 피해가 0.55% 추가로 증가한다."`, `matchAll` yields two results — `qualifier: "적에게"` (value 1.00) and `qualifier: " 치명타 시 적에게"` (value 0.55). **Any filter distinguishing "is this specific bonus crit-triggered?" must test `qualifier`, not the shared `line`** — otherwise both matches get wrongly excluded/included together. This was an ACTIVE BUG being fixed at the point of summarization (see Current Work below).
   - **"증가"/"감소" suffix handling**: Many "주는 피해"/"스킬 피해량" patterns needed the exact suffix word captured (not just assumed to mean increase) — matched via `(증가|감소)?` capture group; when `match[N] === '감소'`, the value must be NEGATED (not dropped/excluded) since it's a genuine debuff/trade-off that reduces the multiplicative total. Dropping it silently was WRONG per explicit user correction ("이거는 -해야지").
   - **Negative-percentage display**: category filters like `damageIncreaseItems.filter(item => item.percent > 0)` incorrectly HID categories whose total went negative (since `-12.07 > 0` is false) — fixed to `.filter(item => item.percent !== 0)`. Also fixed multiple hardcoded `+{value.toFixed(2)}%` JSX templates (which rendered "+-30.00%" for negative values) to conditionally show the sign: `{value >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{value.toFixed(2)}%`.
   - **`appliedLineIndex`**: a `Map<normalizedLine, Set<label>>` built once per render in the parent from ALL already-computed breakdown objects' `.source[].context` fields (not re-scanning), used by the raw-lines modal to show "적용 중 · {labels}" or "미적용" per line — a truthful reflection of what's actually counted, reusing existing computed results rather than reimplementing matching logic.
   - **Equipment/accessory categorization** matches the established convention from `BattleOverview.jsx`: `leftEquipmentTypes = ['무기','투구','상의','하의','장갑','어깨','보주']`, `rightEquipmentTypes = ['목걸이','귀걸이','반지','어빌리티 스톤','팔찌']`, and 나침반/부적 excluded entirely from combat display. Additionally discovered "문장" (Crest) is a PvP-only accessory type (all effects trigger "모험가에게 피격 시") not in either list — now excluded from "장비" tab entirely alongside 보주.
   - Playwright via `playwright-core` + cached Chromium at `C:/Users/User/AppData/Local/ms-playwright/chromium-1228/chrome-win64/chrome.exe`, driven from Bash scripts in the scratchpad directory, always targeting `http://localhost:5173` (CORS-restricted backend origin).

   - "'치명타 시 적에게 주는 피해가 0.55% 증가한다.' 이거는 5번에 들어가야해 '공격이 치명타로 적중 시 적에게 주는 피해가 12.0% 증가하며, 받는 피해가 4.0% 감소합니다.' 이것도" — (almost certainly a typo for "6번" given content is about on-crit damage increase, matching their own just-stated Group 6 definition) these ArkGrid-core-option and ark-passive-node lines with "치명타 시"/"치명타로 적중 시" triggers need to route to the crit-hit-damage bucket instead of leaking into Group 3's generic "적에게 주는 피해".
   - "'치명타 적중률이 24.0% 증가하고, 진화형 피해가 4.0% 증가합니다.' 이건 진화형 피해도 있지만 치명타 적중률도 있짢아 이건 치명타 적정률은 4번에 들어가야하고" (likely typo for "5번", matching their CRIT_RATE=Group5 definition) — "치명타 적중률" (crit rate) mentions embedded inside otherwise-진화형-피해 lines must ALSO be separately extracted into the CRIT_RATE bucket (Group 5), while the 진화형 피해 part stays in Group 3.
   - "'치명타 적중률이 4.0% 증가하고, 진화형 피해가 5.0% 증가합니다.' 이것도 마찬가지 ]" — same treatment, another example.
   - "1,2,4,5,6번 애들도 3번처럼 출처 제대로 보이게 싹다 바꿔" — (LATEST, NOT YET STARTED) Groups 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 should ALL show sources with the same quoted-context transparency that Group 3 (최종 피해 증가) already has.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - React functional components with hooks (useState) in `DamageAnalysis.jsx`
   - Lost Ark Open API armory JSON structure: `ArmoryEquipment` (Type values include 무기/투구/상의/하의/장갑/어깨/목걸이/귀걸이/반지/팔찌/어빌리티 스톤/나침반/부적/보주/문장), `ArmoryEngraving`, `ArkPassive` (Effects with NameTagBox/MultiTextBox structure), `ArkGrid` (Slots with Point-gated `[NP]` core options, plus a separate `Effects` aggregate array like `기본 공격력 총합`/`추가 피해`/`공격력`/`보스 피해`/`낙인력`/`아군 피해 강화`/`아군 공격 강화`), `ArmoryCard`, `ArmoryGem` (`Gems` array + `Effects.Skills` slot→skill mapping)
   - `cleanApiText(value)` from `lib/text.js`: replaces `<br>` with space, strips all HTML tags, decodes entities, collapses whitespace, trims — CRITICALLY this means calling `cleanApiText(x).replace(/<br>/gi,' | ')` (clean-then-replace) is a NO-OP for the replace since cleanApiText already consumed `<br>` — the CORRECT order (used by `tooltipSections`) is `value.replace(/<br>/gi,' | ')` THEN `cleanApiText(...)`.
   - **Korean regex gotcha**: `\b` (word boundary) does NOT work with Hangul characters in JS regex (Hangul isn't in `\w`), causing silent match failures — must use lookaheads like `(?=\s|$)` instead.
   - **Engraving Description text is NOT split by `<br>`** in the scanning pipeline used by `attackPowerBreakdown`/`critDamageBreakdown`'s engraving loops (`cleanApiText(engraving.Description).replace(/<br>/gi,' ')` — no-op replace as above) — meaning a multi-sentence engraving description arrives as ONE long "line" for pattern-matching purposes; JSON conditional-stack `pattern` entries for engravings must include the ENTIRE multi-sentence text, not just the relevant sentence.
   - **Pattern matching for data-ized conditionals**: `front/src/data/damage-analysis-conditional-stacks.json` (currently version 4) holds `entries: [{pattern, appliedStacks, note}]` where `pattern` is a real observed sentence with literal "N" substituted at every point-value that varies by item roll, while numbers that are fixed specs of the effect (e.g. "최대 30중첩") are left as literal digits. At runtime, `patternToMatcher(pattern)` strips all whitespace, escapes regex metacharacters, then replaces literal "N" with `[\d.]+`, producing an anchored `^...$` RegExp. Matching is whitespace-agnostic (`stripWhitespace` removes ALL whitespace, not just collapses it) specifically to avoid a real bug where "N초마다" (no space) in the JSON didn't match live "N초 마다" (with space) text.
   - **"조건부 확인하기" modal**: shows only conditionals whose pattern is registered in the JSON (i.e., truly "데이터화"), each with its actual detected value/stacks; distinct from the "계산식 보기" modal's checkbox-toggle conditionals (which apply the *generic* `DEFAULT_STACK_ASSUMPTION = 12` cap when not JSON-registered).
   - **Line-level vs match-level filtering ("qualifier" precision bug)**: `scanOutgoingDamage(text)` iterates lines (split by `|`) then does `.matchAll(OUTGOING_DAMAGE_PATTERN)` per line, so a SINGLE line can yield MULTIPLE matches, each with its own 
...(truncated, 74199 more chars)

## 3169. Claude

All fixes verified with real armory data and the frontend build is clean. Summary of what landed this turn:

1. **Fixed the crit-hit double-counting bug** in `arkPassiveTierDamageBreakdown` — added the same `CRIT_HIT_TRIGGER_PATTERN` exclusion used elsewhere, checking `qualifier` when available (scanOutgoingDamage matches) and falling back to the full line for `scanTierDamage` matches (which don't capture a qualifier). Verified against real data for both 현승꾸 and 아방파트랏슈: zero crit-hit leakage into any tier bucket (진화/깨달음/도약), and 아방파트랏슈's "회심" node line ("공격이 치명타로 적중 시 적에게 주는 피해가 12.0%...") now routes cleanly into `critHitBracelet` only.

2. **Wired up `critRateFacts`** (Group 5, 치명타 확률 계산) — added the `critRate` computation, a `CRIT_RATE` detail-switch entry, state for its expand toggle, and added it to `buildAppliedLineIndex`. Verified with real data: both of the user's example lines split correctly — "치명타 적중률이 24.0% 증가하고, 진화형 피해가 4.0% 증가합니다." now contributes 24% to CRIT_RATE and 4% to 진화형 피해 (Group 3), not conflated.

3. **Renamed/broadened CRIT_HIT_BRACELET** (Group 6) label from "팔찌 치명타 시 피해 배율" to "치명타 시 주는 피해 배율" with an updated note reflecting it now scans equipment/ArkGrid/ArkPassive, not just bracelets.

4. **Added quoted-source-context display** (matching Group 3's style) to Groups 1, 5, and 6's display components: `MainStatBreakdown`, `WeaponAttackBreakdown`, `BaseAttackRateBreakdown`, `AttackPowerBreakdown` (also gave its conditional rows the same stack-detail expand UI that `WeaponAttackBreakdown` has, since it previously had none), `CritDamageBreakdown`, and the shared `AdditionalDamageBreakdown` (used by CRIT_HIT_EVOLUTION/CRIT_HIT_BRACELET/CRIT_RATE) — all now show `"실제 게임 문구"` under each source, plus fixed sign display (`+`/`-`) for values that can go negative. Group 2 already had this from earlier work, confirmed unchanged.

## 3236. Claude

Done. Fetched armory data for 55 of the 56 characters (`RE트레이너` returned 404 — not found, might be a typo or different server) and scanned all of it against the current calculation logic.

**Two new data files in `front/src/data/`:**

1. **`damage-analysis-conditional-candidates.json`** — 23 "(최대 N중첩)" stacking conditionals found in the data that aren't yet in `damage-analysis-conditional-stacks.json`. Each entry has the raw game text, its detected max-stack count, `appliedStacks: null` (for you to fill in), and which characters/items it came from. When you're ready, move the ones you want into `damage-analysis-conditional-stacks.json` the same way we did earlier (N-template the varying numbers, pick an `appliedStacks`).

2. **`damage-analysis-formula-gap-candidates.json`** — phrases containing 피해/공격력/치명타/적중률 that the current regex scanners don't catch, grouped into 7 categories plus a leftover "otherUncategorized" bucket:
   - **NAMED_SKILL_DAMAGE** (598 lines, 55명) — by far the biggest: ArkGrid core options and ArkPassive 깨달음 nodes that boost one specific named skill's damage (e.g. "레인 오브 불릿의 피해량이 0.6% 증가"). Needs matching against the analyzed skill's name to apply correctly — not something to blindly sum.
   - **ELEMENTAL_DAMAGE** (14, 9명) — "속성 피해" stats, not tracked in any group currently.
   - **MOVE_SPEED_SCALED_DAMAGE** (5, 17명) — damage bonus scaled by move-speed stat, not a flat %.
   - **STAGGER_DAMAGE** (4, 7명) — real example text for Group 4's already-known-unresolved "무력화 대상 피해 배율".
   - **NON_BACK_HEAD_ATTACK_BONUS**, **CRIT_RESISTANCE_DEBUFF**, **FLAT_DAMAGE_NUMBER** — smaller categories, each with notes on why they're structurally tricky.
   - **otherUncategorized** (53) — mostly intricate class-specific "운명:" ArkGrid mechanics with multi-step/conditional-resource scaling, left as raw text for manual judgment call per case.

Along the way I also found and fixed two real, in-scope gaps in the live scanner (not just recorded as candidates): `주는 피해량이` (with 량) and `입히는 피해` (verb synonym for 주는) weren't matching `OUTGOING_DAMAGE_PATTERN` at all — fixed, rebuilt, verified clean.

## 3288. Claude

수정 완료했습니다.

**문제**: `outgoingDamageBreakdown`이 목걸이/귀걸이/반지 연마 효과, 아크그리드 코어 전부(코어 종류 상관없이), 아크그리드 효과 집계까지 전부 한 배열에 넣고 하나의 합계(`total`)로 뭉쳐서 "적에게 주는 피해" 딱 하나의 곱연산 항으로 계산하고 있었습니다.

**수정**: `outgoingDamageBreakdown`이 이제 그룹 목록을 돌려주고, 그룹 나누는 기준은:
- **장신구 연마**(목걸이+귀걸이+반지) → 전부 하나로 합연산되는 한 그룹
- **아크그리드 코어**는 코어 하나(slot.Name)당 별도 그룹 — 같은 코어의 여러 포인트 구간(10P/17P/18P...) 문구끼리만 합연산되고, 다른 코어랑은 절대 안 섞임
- **아크그리드 효과 집계**("보스 피해" 등)도 별도 그룹

그리고 `damageIncreaseItems`(최종 피해 증가 계산)에서 이 그룹들을 각각 독립된 `(1+증가율)` 곱연산 항으로 펼쳐 넣도록 바꿨습니다.

현승꾸 데이터로 검증해보니 실제로 이렇게 나뉩니다:
- 장신구 연마 · 적에게 주는 피해: +2.00%
- 팔찌 · 적에게 주는 피해: +8.50%
- 아크그리드 · 질서의 해 코어 : 파천섬결: +26.00%
- 아크그리드 · 질서의 달 코어 : 연환섬멸: +1.50%
- 아크그리드 · 혼돈의 해 코어 : 현란한 공격: +1.50%
- 아크그리드 · 혼돈의 달 코어 : 불타는 일격: +1.66%
- 아크그리드 효과: +1.00%

말씀하신 "오미너스 따로, 제노사이드 따로" 구조 그대로입니다. 빌드도 정상 통과했습니다.

## 3410. Claude

둘 다 반영했습니다.

**1) "[20P] 악마 스킬의 피해량이 0.2% 증가한다."** — 이건 이미 `SKILL_DAMAGE_PATTERN`("스킬(의)? 피해량이 N%")에 걸려서 정상적으로 잡히고 있었습니다. 다만 오미너스 코어는 캐릭터가 실제로 19포인트만 투자한 상태라 [20P] 줄 자체가 아직 활성화되지 않은 게 맞아서(포인트 게이트로 정상 제외), [10P]/[14P](-30% 감소 포함)/[17P]/[18P]/[19P]는 전부 "질서의 해 코어 : 오미너스" 그룹에 제대로 합산되고 있는 걸 확인했습니다.

**2) "블러드 볼텍스의 피해량이 10.0% 증가한다." (스킬 지정)** — 이건 실제로 안 잡히고 있었던 게 맞았습니다. 새로 스킬명 매칭 로직을 추가해서, 지금 화면에서 분석 중인 스킬 이름이 문장에 그대로 들어있을 때만 반영하도록 했습니다. 아방파트랏슈 데이터로 검증해보니:
- **블러드 볼텍스** 분석 시 → "질서의 별 코어 : 치명적인 할퀴기"에 +10.0%, "질서의 달 코어 : 고어 블리딩"엔 안 잡힘
- **블러드 제노사이드** 분석 시 → "치명적인 할퀴기"에 +14.0%(제노사이드용 문장)
- **리프 블로우**처럼 관련 문구가 없는 스킬 분석 시 → 스킬 지정 보너스 없이 기본값만

말씀하신 대로 코어별로 완전히 분리해서 계산되고, 스킬이 일치할 때만 반영됩니다.

중간에 시전 속도/피해량이 한 문장에 같이 나오는 경우("블러드 볼텍스의 시전 속도가 30% 증가하며, 블러드 피어싱의 피해량이 54% 증가한다") 스킬명 바로 뒤 아무 숫자나 잡아버려서 "블러드 볼텍스"에 엉뚱하게 시전 속도 30%가 피해량으로 잘못 들어가는 버그가 있었는데, 그것도 "피해량"이라는 단어가 실제로 나온 뒤의 숫자만 잡도록 고쳐서 같이 잡았습니다.

또한 이 기능과 겹치던 예전 미완성 코드("선택한 스킬 이름이 포함된 코어 옵션 문장" — 어차피 화면에 안 보이던 죽은 코드였습니다)는 정리했습니다. 빌드 통과 확인했습니다.

## 3478. Claude

6번을 3번(최종 피해 증가)과 같은 방식으로 하나로 묶었습니다. 7번(그 외)은 그대로 뒀습니다.

**전**: CRIT_DAMAGE / CRIT_HIT_EVOLUTION / CRIT_HIT_BRACELET / CRIT_HIT_SYNERGY 4개 행이 따로따로 표시됨

**후**: "최종 치명타 피해 배율" 하나로 통합 — `치명타 피해 배율(기본 200%+각인·장비·아크패시브 합산) × 진화 회심 배율 × 치명타 시 주는 피해 배율`을 전부 곱한 값 하나만 보여줍니다. (CRIT_HIT_SYNERGY는 데이터로 확인 불가라 3번 때와 동일하게 곱셈에서 빠지고 note에만 설명이 남습니다)

현승꾸 데이터로 검증: 치명타 피해 기본 200% + 반지 연마 2.2% = 202.2%, 회심 노드 없음(기공사라 해당 없음) → 최종 202.20%로 정상 계산됨을 확인했습니다.

내부적으로는 3번에 쓰던 `FinalDamageIncreaseBreakdown` 컴포넌트를 재사용하도록 일반화했고(제목/합계 표기 방식을 props로 뺌), 이제 안 쓰는 예전 개별 표시 컴포넌트(`CritDamageBreakdown`)는 정리했습니다. 빌드 통과 확인했습니다.

## 3490. Claude

이 12줄은 로스트아크 오픈API를 호출하는 백엔드(`loark`)에서 캐시 TTL(얼마나 오래 캐시를 믿을지)과 자동 갱신 주기를 환경변수로 조절할 수 있게 뽑아둔 설정입니다. `${ENV_VAR:기본값}` 형식이라 환경변수를 안 주면 콜론 뒤 기본값(밀리초/초 단위)이 쓰입니다.

**시세(개별 아이템 가격) 관련**
- `app.price-cache-ttl-seconds` (기본 60초) — `ApiCacheState`/`PersistentApiCache`에서 쓰는 범용 API 캐시 TTL. 60초 안에는 같은 요청이 와도 API를 다시 안 부르고 캐시된 값을 씁니다.
- `app.market-cache-ttl-seconds` (기본 300초=5분) — `MarketService`의 인메모리(Caffeine) 시세 캐시 TTL.
- `app.market-refresh-min-interval-ms` (기본 2500ms) — 시세 하나를 새로 갱신한 직후 그 스레드를 강제로 `Thread.sleep`시켜서, 연속 요청이 몰려도 오픈API를 너무 빨리 연타하지 않도록 하는 최소 간격(레이트 리밋 방지용)입니다.
- `app.market-refresh-interval-ms` (기본 300000ms=5분) / `app.market-refresh-initial-delay-ms` (기본 120000ms=2분) — `MarketService`의 `@Scheduled` 전체 시세 자동 갱신 배치가 앱 기동 2분 후부터 시작해서 5분마다 반복 실행되게 하는 값입니다.

**경매장(팔찌/어빌리티스톤) 관련**
- `app.auction-cache-ttl-seconds` (기본 900초=15분) — 팔찌·어빌리티스톤 경매장 캐시 TTL(`BraceletAuctionService`/`AbilityStoneAuctionService` 공용).
- `app.bracelet-sample-pages` (기본 10) — 팔찌 시세를 추정할 때 경매장 몇 페이지까지 샘플링해서 통계 낼지.
- `app.auction-refresh-interval-ms` (기본 900000ms=15분) — 팔찌 경매장 자동 갱신 반복 주기(고대/유물 등급 공용).
- `app.bracelet-ancient-refresh-initial-delay-ms` (기본 15000ms=15초) / `app.bracelet-relic-refresh-initial-delay-ms` (기본 90000ms=90초) — 고대 등급과 유물 등급 갱신이 같은 15분 주기를 쓰지만 시작 시각을 서로 다르게(15초 vs 90초 후) 둬서, 두 스케줄이 동시에 겹쳐 API를 한꺼번에 두 번 때리지 않도록 일부러 어긋나게 한 값입니다.
- `app.ability-stone-refresh-interval-ms` (기본 600000ms=10분) / `app.ability-stone-refresh-initial-delay-ms` (기본 5000ms=5초) — 어빌리티스톤 경매장 자동 갱신 주기/시작 지연.

정리하면 전부 "이 데이터를 얼마나 오래 신선하다고 볼지(TTL)"와 "백그라운드 자동 갱신을 언제, 얼마나 자주 돌릴지(interval/initial-delay)"를 캐시별로 따로 튜닝할 수 있게 해둔 값들입니다.

- `app.market-cache-ttl-seconds` (기본 300초=5분) — `MarketService`의 인메모리(Caffeine) 시세 캐시 TTL.
- `app.market-refresh-min-interval-ms` (기본 2500ms) — 시세 하나를 새로 갱신한 직후 그 스레드를 강제로 `Thread.sleep`시켜서, 연속 요청이 몰려도 오픈API를 너무 빨리 연타하지 않도록 하는 최소 간격(레이트 리밋 방지용)입니다.
- `app.market-refresh-interval-ms` (기본 300000ms=5분) / `app.market-refresh-initial-delay-ms` (기본 120000ms=2분) — `MarketService`의 `@Scheduled` 전체 시세 자동 갱신 배치가 앱 기동 2분 후부터 시작해서 5분마다 반복 실행되게 하는 값입니다.

**경매장(팔찌/어빌리티스톤) 관련**
- `app.auction-cache-ttl-seconds` (기본 900초=15분) — 팔찌·어빌리티스톤 경매장 캐시 TTL(`BraceletAuctionService`/`AbilityStoneAuctionService` 공용).
- `app.bracelet-sample-pages` (기본 10) — 팔찌 시세를 추정할 때 경매장 몇 페이지까지 샘플링해서 통계 낼지.
- `app.auction-refresh-interval-ms` (기본 900000ms=15분) — 팔찌 경매장 자동 갱신 반복 주기(고대/유물 등급 공용).
- `app.bracelet-ancient-refresh-initial-delay-ms` (기본 15000ms=15초) / `app.bracelet-relic-refresh-initial-delay-ms` (기본 90000ms=90초) — 고대 등급과 유물 등급 갱신이 같은 15분 주기를 쓰지만 시작 시각을 서로 다르게(15초 vs 90초 후) 둬서, 두 스케줄이 동시에 겹쳐 API를 한꺼번에 두 번 때리지 않도록 일부러 어긋나게 한 값입니다.
- `app.ability-stone-refresh-interval-ms` (기본 600000ms=10분) / `app.ability-stone-refresh-initial-delay-ms` (기본 5000ms=5초) — 어빌리티스톤 경매장 자동 갱신 주기/시작 지연.

정리하면 전부 "이 데이터를 얼마나 오래 신선하다고 볼지(TTL)"와 "백그라운드 자동 갱신을 언제, 얼마나 자주 돌릴지(interval/initial-delay)"를 캐시별로 따로 튜닝할 수 있게 해둔 값들입니다.

---

감사 결과 정리했습니다:

**진짜 "요청 들어올 때마다 실시간" (공유 캐시 없음)**
- `CharacterService.java` — 캐릭터 검색할 때마다 `/armories/characters/{name}` + `/characters/{name}/siblings` 라이브 호출. DB 스냅샷은 API 실패했을 때만 쓰는 폴백이지 평소 캐시가 아님.

**공유 캐시(DB) 있긴 한데, TTL이 60초라 사실상 계속 다시 부름**
- `MarketService.java` — 거래소 아이템 검색(`/markets/items`)·옵션(`/markets/options`)
- `BraceletAuctionService.java` — 팔찌 시세(`/auctions/items`)
- `AbilityStoneAuctionService.java` — 어빌리티 스톤 시세(`/auctions/items`)

이 셋은 `app.price-cache-ttl-seconds` 설정값(기본 **60초**)이 지나면 캐시가 만료돼서 재조회함. 특히 `BraceletAuctionService`가 제일 많이 부르는데, 옵션 조합 6개 × 페이지 최대 10개 = **최대 약 60번의 `/auctions/items` 호출을 60초마다 병렬로(parallelStream)** 날립니다. 방문자별이 아니라 전체 공유 캐시지만, 방문자가 있든 없든 60초 주기로 계속 나갑니다.

**아예 다른 곳 (오픈 API 아님)**
- `MariShopService.java` — 이건 `developer-lostark.game.onstove.com`이 아니라 `m-lostark.game.onstove.com/Shop`을 긁는 거고, 하루 2번(06시/18시) 자체 스케줄러로만 돕니다.

**추가로 확인한 것**: `LostArkRequestContext`는 이름과 달리 **속도 제한/큐잉을 전혀 안 합니다** — 그냥 로깅용 스레드 라벨일 뿐이고, 실제 API 호출은 전부 동시에 나갑니다. 요청 제한은 순전히 로스트아크 쪽 서버가 알아서 거는 것에 의존하는 구조예요. 방금 만든 오늘의 콘텐츠 스케줄러(시간당 1번)에 비하면, `BraceletAuctionService`가 지금 API 부하 대부분을 차지하고 있을 가능성이 높습니다.

## 3548. Claude

bb42acf0 세션(그 "API 호출 감사" 세션이 맞았던 것 같습니다) 안에, 제가 먼저 서브에이전트한테 조사시킨 원본 영어 리포트가 있는데 거기서 정확히 "token bucket"이라는 단어가 나옵니다 — 이게 찾으시던 그 "토큰" 언급인 것 같습니다:

---

## Audit: Live Lost Ark Open API Calls

**Rate limiting/queueing (`config/LostArkRequestContext.java` + `config/ApiConfig.java:19-58`):** `LostArkRequestContext`는 그냥 `ThreadLocal<String>` 라벨러(로깅용)일 뿐이고, `ApiConfig.lostArkRestClient`는 요청/응답을 로깅하는 인터셉터가 달린 공유 `RestClient` 하나를 만듭니다. **세마포어도, 토큰 버킷(token bucket)도, 프로세스 내 직렬화도 전혀 없습니다** — 모든 호출이 그냥 동시에 나가고, 오직 로스트아크 서버 쪽에서 알아서 거는 제한에만 의존합니다.

### 실시간, 사용자별, 공유 캐시 없음
- `CharacterService.java` — 캐릭터 검색마다 `/armories/characters/{name}` + `/characters/{name}/siblings` 라이브 호출

### 공유 캐시(PersistentApiCache)는 있지만 TTL이 짧음
- `MarketService.java`(`/markets/items`, `/markets/options`), `BraceletAuctionService.java`, `AbilityStoneAuctionService.java` — 셋 다 `persistentCache.findFresh()`를 먼저 확인
- 중요한 건: 이 셋의 TTL이 `app.price-cache-ttl-seconds`(**기본 60초**)라서, DB 공유 캐시이긴 해도 고유 캐시 키마다 약 60초에 한 번씩 실제 API를 다시 때립니다. `BraceletAuctionService`가 제일 많이 부르는데, 옵션 조합 6개 × 페이지 최대 10개 = 최대 약 60번의 `/auctions/items` 호출을 60초마다 병렬로 날립니다.

### 아예 다른 곳
- `MariShopService.java` — 오픈API가 아니라 `m-lostark.game.onstove.com/Shop`을 긁는 거고, 하루 2번(06시/18시) 자체 스케줄러로만 돕니다.

---

이게 맞는 것 같나요? ("토큰 버킷"이 없다 = 속도 제한을 코드가 직접 안 걸고 로스트아크 서버에만 의존한다는 뜻이었습니다.)

<result>**Yes, Claude Code has a built-in export feature.** Here's the exact mechanism:

**Command:** `/export`

**How it works:**
- Run `/export` to open a menu with two options:
  1. Copy the current conversation to your clipboard
  2. Save it as a plain-text file
- **Optional:** Pass a filename directly (e.g., `/export transcript.txt`) to skip the menu and write directly to that file

**Output format:** Plain text with messages and tool outputs rendered as readable text (not raw JSON)

**Alternative (for scripts/automation):**
- Session transcripts are stored as JSONL at `~/.claude/projects/&lt;project&gt;/&lt;session-id&gt;.jsonl`
- You can also export structured JSON output from non-interactive runs using `claude -p --output-format json`

**`/export` ≠ `/insights`**

According to the official docs, **`/export` should produce plain-text transcripts**, not insights reports. It has two menu options:

2. Save as plain-text file with messages/tool outputs rendered as readable text

**`/insights`** is a separate command that generates an analysis report of your session patterns and activity trends.

- There could be a configuration or plugin interfering with `/export` behavior
- The installed Claude Code version may be older/newer than documentation

- Run `claude --version` to check if they're on v2.1.220 (latest)
- Try `/export` again and confirm the menu options shown
- Confirm they're not accidentally running `/insights`

The official documentation (as of July 25, 2026) confirms `/export` should output plain-text transcripts, not insights HTML reports.
